data.description: Palace-Branded Elegance in Green Gate at Dubai Creek Harbour
data.display_address: Lyvia by Palace, Dubai Creek Harbour (The Lagoons), Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience refined waterfront living at Lyvia by Palace, a signature development by Emaar located in the heart of Green Gate. This residential tower captures the essence of the Palace brand through thoughtful design, natural aesthetics, and a strong connection to its surroundings.

Homes feature expansive layouts enhanced by floor-to-ceiling windows, allowing natural light to flood the interiors while framing breathtaking views of the creek and city skyline. Every detail is carefully curated to balance comfort, functionality, and understated luxury.

The community offers a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including landscaped gardens, wellness-focused spaces, family-friendly outdoor areas, and social zones ideal for relaxation and entertaining.
